title: [The Dragon Macaw, Deck]
description: The expansive deck is made of highly polished teak with occasional gear-shaped scuffs providing purchase.  Twists of colorful sailcloth stitched with stylized dragon-like parrots swoop between ironwood poles and hold dozens of tiny crystalline lamps glittering in the sunlight.  A gear-framed sign points toward the main cabin, which is invitingly open, but all other egresses into the ship are heavily guarded by scowling burghal gnomes armed to the teeth.
